findings.span: This cleanser works really well for daily use
findings.why: A customer quote saying the cleanser works really well is still a testimonial used as a performance statement. The disclaimer now on the image helps, but the quote is a general efficacy endorsement, so a reviewer will likely want it confirmed as genuine and representative.
findings.fix: Confirm the review is genuine and representative of the 4.1 rating, or swap to a quote about feel or use, e.g. a line on how the foam feels.

tone_read: Calm, proof-led ad with no fear or hype; the performance quote is the only weight-bearing element.
language_read: Strength 2% is in the product name and clarified as combined BHA + LHA. The disclaimer now sits on the image.
